content: We used the large version of the universal sentence encoder with a transformer BIBREF23 . We did not update the pretrained sentence encoder parameters during training. All hyperparamaters for all models (including hidden layers, hidden sizes, and dropout) were tuned using Vizier BIBREF24 via 10-fold cross validation on the training set maximizing for F1.
